column1: # Words Persian speakers routinely write in the Persian script but which are
# NOT phonetically derivable from the Finglish phonetic rules: English spelling
# says little about English sound, so "mobile" would come out مبیله and
# "computer" کمپوتر. Typed on the Persian phonetic layout, the English
# spelling on the left commits the Persian on the right.
# Kept short on purpose. A word is here only if the Persian script is how it is
# normally written in Persian text (موبایل, اینترنت, دکتر); a Persian word for
# the thing (دوربین for camera, دانشگاه for university) is a translation, not a
# loan, and is left out. Compounds are written the way the fa word list writes
# them (لپتاپ, وبسایت). A draft that wants a Persian speaker's review.
# Format: spelling<TAB>persian   (one mapping per line; # starts a comment)
